episode_summary: In this episode, Alex Maldonado shares strategies for helping first-time buyers navigate closing costs through seller and lender credits. He discusses the importance of bilingual marketing in reaching the Hispanic community and optimizing Google business profiles for better visibility. Additionally, Alex provides insights into leveraging down payment assistance programs and the value of consistent social media efforts.
